responsibility: Implements gm2’s main declaration-building pass. It creates and fills symbol-table entries for constants, variables, subranges, arrays, records, variants, formal parameters, procedure and procedure-type signatures, optional and varargs parameters, alignments, and module ctor/init/fini metadata; tracks constant-expression kind information for sets, strings, constructors, casts, and numeric classes; and coordinates scope and block state so the symbol table is complete enough for later constant-resolution and code-generation passes.
same_name_distinction: This implementation module contains the executable pass-2 symbol-building logic behind the P2SymBuild interface; unlike P2SymBuild.def, it performs the actual scope updates, symbol creation, and constant-kind/type tracking.
